statement: For the geometric twelve-vertex A5 action, the pure centralizers of a chosen C5 and its D10 normalizer are the same explicitly embedded free group of rank six, and the same equality holds in the full completion. Of the twelve specified seven-point restrictions, two are trivial on this subgroup and the other ten have the same kernel by actual D10 transports. Their joint kernel, including all twenty-four six-point restrictions, is the kernel of the displayed configuration map t -> (1,zeta^2,zeta^4,t,t*zeta,t*zeta^4,infinity). The explicit based source word [m_zeta2,m_zeta1*m_zeta3*m_zero] is nontrivial and maps to the identity braid. Its closure is a full Zhat in the common completed kernel and, by F10, has trivial intersection with the residual A5 centralizer.
where_proved: Part F, statement F.11; work/part_a/f_c5_kernel.tex; code/part_a/c5_seven_kernel_exact.py and code/part_a/c5_centralizer_labels_f11.py with exact outputs
depends_on: A12 discrete Dehn-Nielsen-Baer and point-pushing/inner-conjugation comparison; A7 trivial centre of the free profinite group; F7 justified prime-order centralizer comparison and exact 36 restriction maps; F10 full procyclic exclusion; A-Artin1947 Theorems 3 and 14

depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The exact unramified F11 <= F3 covering, extension of a centralizing outer class, based quotient monodromy, full point-pushing detector, actual Mobius labels, D10 transports, source paths, crossing field, and source Heisenberg detector are all displayed.
notes: The pure discrete centralizer is identified through the actual cover z -> z^5 and the index-five cover X5 -> P1 minus {0,1,infinity}; the F3 conjugation extension proves descent for the entire centralizer. The family has the global labelled transformations d(z)=zeta*z and tau_t(z)=t/z, proving equality with the D10 centralizer. Retaining both poles, the first full five-cycle and one point of the second gives an exact point-pushing map whose full completion acts by Inn on Fhat6, proving its full induced topology. The exact finite model uses theta^4-5theta^2+5=0, k=1-theta^2 and t0=k*zeta^2, with a(z)=(1-z)/(1-z/k), b(z)=a(zeta*z). It checks 720 point images and 120 Cayley-generator matrix products, the one ten-set normalizer orbit, two constant seven-maps, and all 24 six-set factorizations. A straight basepoint path from t0 to 2+2i has real part at least two. The exact braid certificate uses rational interval signs in Q(theta), with 24 segments, 360 coordinate-pair checks and 58 simple crossings. The four source meridian words have lengths 14,8,20,16; the second commutator factor freely reduces to length20 and the commutator braid to length48. The faithful Artin substitution gives the identity. A class-two Heisenberg coordinate equals one, proving nontriviality and detecting every prime coordinate of the full procyclic closure. This proves noninjectivity of the restriction route on another actual solvable centralizer. The residual A5 centralizer remains Open.
